analysis.headline: USD/KRW surges to 1,358 ahead of U.S. payrolls before exporter selling buffers
analysis.summary: USD/KRW surged to roughly 1,358 (ECB ref 1,358.73) as pre-NFP caution and Wall Street tech sell-offs spurred safe-haven dollar demand, briefly touching 1,364 KRW. However, heavy exporter dollar-selling (nego) clustered near the 1,360 mark contained further upside, settling the pair in a 1,352–1,364 KRW range.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW advances to 1,517 as KRW weakness offsets softer euro data
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW climbed to approximately 1,517 (ECB ref 1,517.02). Although EUR/USD eased to 1.1165 amid broad dollar strength and soft Eurozone retail sales, steeper depreciation in the Korean won lifted the cross rate. Risk-off sentiment triggered by global tech declines supported the pair firmly in a 1,512–1,522 KRW range.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW rebounds to 858.2 KRW per 100 JPY on intervention alerts and sell-off
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW rebounded to around 8.58 KRW per 1 JPY (~858.2 KRW per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.582). While USD/JPY trading near 158 capped yen momentum, stern verbal intervention warnings from Tokyo and foreign equity outflows from Seoul cushioned the cross, anchoring trading solidly within an 854–862 KRW band.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW leaps to 1,818 driven by BoE 4.0% rate hike and resilient sterling
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW advanced sharply toward 1,818 (ECB ref 1,818.64), underpinned by the Bank of England's recent 25bp hike to 4.0% and persistent hawkish policy divergence. Sterling held up solidly across crosses despite broader dollar gains, propelling the pair higher within an active 1,812–1,825 KRW trading band.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW rises to 203.7 on PBOC liquidity support and NPC stimulus hopes
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW climbed to around 203.7 (ECB ref 203.67) within an elevated 202–205 band. The People's Bank of China provided ample short-term liquidity and firm reference fixings, while anticipation of the NPC Standing Committee's fiscal package buoyed sentiment. In line with the USD/KRW surge, the cross closed firm at 202.5–204.5 KRW.

AUD.headline: Australian dollar steadies near 933.6 KRW on hawkish RBA and commodities
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar held steady near 933.6 KRW as the Reserve Bank of Australia's hawkish stance and commodity price resilience mitigated broad U.S. dollar strength.

CAD.headline: Canadian dollar defends 965.9 KRW supported by crude oil and energy exports
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar held firmly near 965.9 KRW, supported by steady crude oil markets and resilient energy trade that offset Bank of Canada interest rate cuts.

CHF.headline: Swiss franc climbs to 1,659.2 KRW on safe-haven flows amid tech sell-off
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc advanced to 1,659.2 KRW as Wall Street equity declines and rising global market volatility spurred safe-haven and hedging demand.

CNY.headline: Chinese yuan advances to 203.7 KRW on PBOC liquidity and NPC stimulus hopes
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan climbed to 203.7 KRW, anchored by ample PBOC liquidity, reliable fixing guidance, and strong anticipation for the NPC fiscal stimulus program.

EUR.headline: Euro advances to 1,517.0 KRW as won depreciation outweighs softer EU data
EUR.brief: The euro rose to 1,517.0 KRW as steeper Korean won depreciation and cross buying outweighed softer Eurozone retail sales and EUR/USD easing to 1.1165.

GBP.headline: British pound leaps to 1,818.6 KRW on BoE 4.0% rate hike and cross demand
GBP.brief: Sterling jumped to 1,818.6 KRW, buoyed by the Bank of England's recent rate hike to 4.0% and strong cross-currency demand against Asian currencies.

HKD.headline: Hong Kong dollar tracks USD strength within peg corridor near 173.4 KRW
HKD.brief: The Hong Kong dollar tracked the U.S. dollar's advance within the 7.75–7.85 peg band, consolidating near 173.4 KRW amid active regional capital adjustments.

JPY.headline: Japanese yen rebounds to 858.2 KRW per 100 JPY on intervention warnings
JPY.brief: The yen rebounded to 858.2 KRW per 100 JPY as Tokyo's firm intervention warnings and broader won softness countered pressure from USD/JPY hovering near 158.

KRW.headline: Korean won defends 1,360 KRW zone anchored by exporter sales and 3.00% rate
KRW.brief: The won softened toward 1,358 KRW on foreign equity selling and pre-NFP dollar gains, but exporter selling near 1,360 KRW and the 3.00% base rate limited losses.

USD.headline: U.S. dollar surges to 1,358 KRW ahead of payrolls before exporter capping
USD.brief: The U.S. dollar surged to 1,358 KRW on pre-payroll caution and global risk-off sentiment, though heavy corporate exporter selling capped gains near 1,360 KRW.
